The '''Lord Admiral''' is the current ruler of the human kingdom and nation of [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)|Kul Tiras]]. The successor to Lord Admiral [[Daelin Proudmoore]], who fell in Theramore at the hands of the Mok'nathal [[Rexxar]] and his allies, it was under the Lord Admiral's rule that Kul Tiras isolated itself from the new [[Alliance]] that rose in the place of the [[Alliance of Lordaeron]], estranged from their sister kingdoms that attempted to make peace with the [[Horde]].

Several years after the battle of Mount Hyjal, the Lord Admiral opened diplomatic relations with Stormwind once again, sending [[Vice Admiral Renhoff]] and [[Emissary Godwin Valorcall]] to establish the embassy of [[Davenburg]] and represent Kul Tiras before Stormwind, and determine if the southern kingdom's interests still align with those of the old Alliance.<ref>[[Vice Admiral Renhoff#Quotes]]</ref><ref>[[Emissary Godwin Valorcall#Quotes]]</ref>
